name: Taxi Booking Confirmation
description: Confirmation email sent when a taxi is booked
subject: Taxi Booking Confirmation - Booking #{booking_id}
body_html:
Taxi Booking Confirmation

Dear {customer_name},

Your taxi has been booked successfully!

Booking Details

Booking ID:#{booking_id}
Pickup Location:{pickup_location}
Destination:{destination}
Pickup Date:{pickup_date}
Pickup Time:{pickup_time}
Fare:£{fare}
Payment Method:{payment_method}
Driver:{driver_name} (Vehicle: {vehicle_reg})

Your taxi will arrive at the pickup location at the scheduled time.

Note: If you need to cancel or modify your booking, please contact us at least 1 hour before the pickup time.

Best regards,
Taxi Service

customer_name.description: Name of the customer who booked the taxi
